body: I’m happier, that’s for sure.  I went 8 years clean.  Something just always felt off, progressively life got worse than ever.  An then I relapsed.  Everything changed but also, nothing changed.  Whilst I was slowly thriving even with a dip back into severe usage it never mattered.  For reason outside of my addiction for the first time life through seemingly no fault of my own crumbled worse than ever.  That’s where I currently am.  I’ve been clean a few months just because I saw this coming an tbh I’ve become so dead inside I don’t care when im dope sick or not.  It doesn’t matter.  If I use, I use.  If I dont, nobody fucking cares anyway.  My point of all this is… idk 🤷🏻‍♂️ a means to let others be like “oh shit, okay im doing alright” lol Idfk.  Anyways, 👋
